description_en: Queries the details of a video stream push job, including the creation time, current push status, job type, and push URL
description_zh: 调用接口QueryStreamPushJob查询视频推流任务详情：创建时间、当前推流状态、任务类型、推流地址等
name: QueryStreamPushJob

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab of the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The request was successful.
Other codes: An error occurred. For more information about error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The result returned if the call is successful

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，单位为秒

JobType.description_en:
The type of the stream push job. Valid values:

1: continuous job.
2: trigger-based job that ends after an interruption
JobType.description_zh:
推流任务类型。

1：持续型任务。
2：触发式任务，中断后结束

PushStatus.description_en:
The current push status. Valid values:

1: pushing.
2: waiting to push.
3: push ended
PushStatus.description_zh:
当前推流状态。

1：正在推流。
2：等待推流。
3：推流结束

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

0: main stream.
1: sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型。

0：主码流 。
1：辅码流

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
